summary: Show Company Action Plan Template Item Assignee
description: Details of a single Company Action Plan Template Item Assignee

schema.description: Company Action Plan Template Item Assignee (Show)

id.description: Unique identifier of the template item assignee.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the assignee was created. ISO 8601 format.

is_holding.description: Whether this assignee must sign off at a hold point before subsequent work can proceed.

plan_template_id.description: Unique identifier of the parent Action Plan Template.

role.description: Organizational role of the assignee within the inspection workflow.

updated_at.description: Timestamp when the assignee was last modified. ISO 8601 format.

id.description: Unique identifier of the verification method.

active.description: Whether this verification method is enabled for selection in template items.

name.description: Display name of the verification method.

source_key.description: System key identifying a built-in verification method. Null for user-created custom methods.
